records.title: Aligning by Misaligning: Boundary-aware Curriculum Learning for Multimodal Alignment
records.reason: The work is a multimodal alignment curriculum-learning method and reports model-quality gains, not inference or model-deployment efficiency.

records.title: EnsembleNER: Ensembling Large Language Models for Zero-Shot Named Entity Recognition
records.reason: The paper improves zero-shot NER through multi-LLM ensembling and selection; it does not claim to reduce inference cost, latency, or memory.

records.title: ESCA: Enabling Seamless Codec Avatar Execution through Algorithm and Hardware Co-Optimization for Virtual Reality
records.reason: The work targets codec-avatar execution for VR, not large-language-model inference or serving.

records.title: Binary Quadratic Quantization: Beyond First-Order Quantization for Real-Valued Matrix Compression
records.reason: The checked experiments do not demonstrate LLM compression or inference; transferring this generic matrix technique to LLMs remains unverified, and the paper notes non-negligible quantization cost.

records.title: Session Summary Podcast: Session 1: Systems for AI (LLMs) - 1
records.reason: This is a session-summary podcast artifact rather than a research contribution to inference efficiency.
